subject.title: Agent lane lacks first-class scoped node exec path and stale nodes can hang or fail roughly

question: After the merged selectable-node-exec path, should OpenClaw standardize a model-facing retryable stale-node result for Codex node execution, or should existing node availability errors remain the canonical contract?
rationale: The remaining request affects how a security-sensitive remote-shell capability exposes connectivity state to models and callers; code inspection alone cannot choose the permanent error and retry contract.

options.title: Define a bounded stale-node contract
options.body: Keep this issue focused and specify a typed retryable unavailable response at the owner-side node-exec adapter without weakening approval or connectivity checks.

options.title: Keep existing node errors
options.body: Close the remaining request if maintainers consider current node-unavailable behavior the intended contract and do not want a new model-facing error shape.

recommendation.title: Define a bounded stale-node contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue focused and specify a typed retryable unavailable response at the owner-side node-exec adapter without weakening approval or connectivity checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the mixed-session node-exec adapter and its intended behavior boundary.
